ordering.manifest_payload_order: lexicographic UTF-8 byte order by normalized path
ordering.zip_entry_order: manifest.json, metadata/photos.json, checksums.json, then all remaining entries lexicographically

compression.timestamps: zeroed DOS timestamp where the writer permits it

compatibility.same_major: accept only known required structures and apply declared minor compatibility rules
compatibility.older_major: accept only through an explicit migration before validation
compatibility.unknown_optional_entry: reject unless its namespace is explicitly registered
